$comment: Merged into ~/.cursor/hooks.json alongside whatever is already there (rtk, etc.).
Cursor's schema differs from Claude Code's: camelCase events, a flat hooks object, and
entries of the shape { command, matcher }. The scripts detect which agent called them.
The 'stop' hook cannot block -- it can only auto-submit a follow-up message, bounded by
Cursor's loop_limit. That is weaker than Claude Code's Stop hook and is not parity.
